repos.description: Display and control your Android device
repos.summary_zh: scrcpy 是一款高性能、低延迟的 Android 设备屏幕镜像与控制工具，支持 USB/TCP 连接，无需 root 或额外应用。具备 30~120fps 流畅传输、1920×1080 高清画质、35~70ms 低延迟、1 秒内启动等特性，并提供音频转发、录制、虚拟显示、键盘鼠标模拟、游戏手柄支持等丰富功能，适用于 Linux、Windows、macOS 三大平台。
repos.summary_en: scrcpy is a lightweight, high-performance Android device mirroring and control tool that supports USB/TCP connections without requiring root access or additional apps. It delivers 30~120fps video at 1920×1080+ quality with 35~70ms latency and sub-second startup. Features include audio forwarding, recording, virtual display, HID keyboard/mouse simulation, gamepad support, and more, available on Linux, Windows, and macOS.

repos.description: :arrow_double_down: Dumb downloader that scrapes the web
repos.summary_zh: You-Get 是一个轻量级命令行工具，用于从互联网下载视频、音频和图片内容，尤其适用于无官方下载渠道的网站。支持 YouTube、优酷等主流平台，具备流媒体播放、字幕下载及网页图片抓取功能，依赖 Python 和 FFmpeg，是开源的网页内容抓取工具。
repos.summary_en: You-Get is a lightweight command-line utility to download media (videos, audios, images) from the web when no official download option exists. It supports platforms like YouTube and Youku, enables streaming playback, subtitle extraction, and image scraping, and relies on Python and FFmpeg as core dependencies.

repos.description: 利用AI大模型，一键生成高清短视频 Generate short videos with one click using AI LLM.
repos.summary_zh: MoneyPrinterTurbo 是一款基于 AI 大模型的智能短视频生成工具，支持一键生成高清横竖屏视频。用户只需输入主题或关键词，即可自动完成文案生成、素材匹配、语音合成、字幕添加及背景音乐配置，全面覆盖视频创作流程，支持多模型接入与批量处理，适用于内容创作者快速产出高质量短视频。
repos.summary_en: MoneyPrinterTurbo is an AI-powered short video generation tool that leverages large language models to automatically create high-definition videos with one click. Users input a topic or keyword to generate scripts, visuals, voiceovers, subtitles, and background music. It supports multiple AI models, batch processing, and both vertical and horizontal formats, ideal for content creators seeking efficient video production.

repos.description: The open-source CapCut alternative
repos.summary_zh: OpenCut 是一款免费开源的视频编辑器，支持网页、桌面和移动端，提供时间轴编辑、多轨道支持、实时预览等功能，无水印且无需订阅。注重隐私保护，所有视频处理在本地完成，核心功能对标 CapCut，适合追求简洁高效的用户。
repos.summary_en: OpenCut is a free, open-source video editor for web, desktop, and mobile, offering timeline-based editing, multi-track support, and real-time preview. It emphasizes privacy by processing videos locally, avoids watermarks, and targets users seeking CapCut-like simplicity without paywalled features.

repos.description: 🎥      Make videos programmatically with React
repos.summary_zh: Remotion 是一个基于 React 的视频编程框架，允许开发者使用 Web 技术（如 CSS、Canvas、SVG、WebGL）和 React 组件库来创建动态视频。它支持变量、API 调用、算法等编程能力，适用于个性化视频生成、数据可视化动画等场景，如 GitHub Unwrapped 年度报告。
repos.summary_en: Remotion is a React-based framework for programmatically creating videos using web technologies like CSS, Canvas, SVG, and WebGL. It enables dynamic video generation through programming logic, reusable components, and real-time preview, ideal for personalized content, data-driven animations, and automated video production.

repos.description: 我的电视 电视直播软件，安装即可使用
repos.summary_zh: 我的电视是一款专为智能电视和盒子设计的直播软件，支持U盘安装、ADB部署及小米电视助手安装，提供即装即用的电视直播服务。具备频道收藏、多平台适配等基础功能，适用于Android设备，但部分老旧机型存在兼容性问题。
repos.summary_en: My TV is a ready-to-use live streaming app for smart TVs and Android boxes, supporting USB installation, ADB deployment, and Mi TV Assistant. It offers basic features like channel favorites and multi-platform compatibility, though some legacy devices may face instability or incompatibility issues.

repos.summary_zh: Roop 是一款一键式人脸替换工具，支持将视频中的面部替换为任意单张图片中的面孔，无需训练或数据集。基于深度学习技术，提供 CPU/GPU 加速，适用于视频角色动画、影视特效等创作场景，同时内置伦理限制以防范滥用。
repos.summary_en: Roop is a one-click face swap tool that replaces faces in videos using a single image, without requiring training or datasets. Powered by deep learning with CPU/GPU acceleration, it supports creative applications like character animation and film effects, while incorporating safeguards against misuse.

repos.description: Open-Sora: Democratizing Efficient Video Production for All
repos.summary_zh: Open-Sora 是一个开源的高效视频生成项目，致力于降低高质量视频制作的技术门槛。其核心亮点包括11B参数模型在VBench和人类偏好测试中与顶尖模型性能相当，仅需20万美元成本即可训练，并完全开放权重与代码。支持从1B到11B多规模模型，结合3D-VAE、rectified flow等创新架构，显著提升生成质量与效率。
repos.summary_en: Open-Sora is an open-source initiative for efficient high-quality video generation, democratizing access to advanced video creation. Its 11B model matches top-tier performance on VBench and human preference tests at just $200K training cost, with full checkpoint and code transparency. Featuring scalable architectures like 3D-VAE and rectified flow, it enables accessible, high-fidelity video production across model sizes from 1B to 11B.

repos.description: 插件化、定制化、无广告的免费音乐播放器
repos.summary_zh: MusicFree 是一款开源、无广告、插件化的免费音乐播放器，专为 Android 和 Harmony OS 设计。其核心特性包括完全本地化数据存储、支持自定义主题与歌词关联功能。通过插件架构，用户可接入第三方音源（如音乐搜索、歌单导入、歌词获取），实现高度定制化体验。项目基于 AGPL 3.0 协议开源，强调隐私保护与合法合规使用。
repos.summary_en: MusicFree is an open-source, ad-free, plugin-based music player for Android and Harmony OS. It features local data storage, customizable themes, and lyric linking. Its plugin architecture enables integration with third-party audio sources for search, playback, and playlist import. Built on AGPL 3.0, it prioritizes privacy and ethical use without VIP or cracked content.

repos.description: An Open Source YouTube app for privacy
repos.summary_zh: FreeTube 是一款注重隐私的开源桌面 YouTube 播放器，基于 Electron 跨平台运行。它通过内置提取器和 Invidious API 绕过官方接口获取视频数据，避免使用 Google 的 cookies 和 JavaScript 追踪用户行为，所有订阅、播放列表和历史记录均本地存储。支持无广告观看、频道订阅无需登录、代理连接（如 Tor）及多配置文件管理，为用户提供去中心化、反追踪的 YouTube 体验。
repos.summary_en: FreeTube is an open-source desktop YouTube player built with privacy in mind, using Electron for cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux). It bypasses official APIs via a built-in extractor or optional Invidious API to deliver ad-free videos without Google tracking through cookies or JavaScript. All data—subscriptions, playlists, and history—is stored locally. Features include anonymous channel subscriptions, proxy integration (e.g., Tor), profile-based feed organization, and full offline access to personalized content.

repos.description: Apple TV Aerial Screensaver for Mac
repos.summary_zh: Aerial 是一款 macOS 屏保程序，基于 Apple TV 的 Aerial 系列航拍视频，展示纽约、旧金山、夏威夷、中国等地的壮丽景色。支持多语言地理特征标注、实时天气与预报，开源协作，兼容 Apple Silicon。
repos.summary_en: Aerial is a macOS screensaver featuring Apple's Aerial video collection, showcasing aerial views of locations like New York, San Francisco, and Hawaii. It supports multilingual overlays, real-time weather data, and is open-source with community contributions.

repos.description: Open source Loom alternative. Beautiful, shareable screen recordings.
repos.summary_zh: Cap 是一款开源的 Loom 替代工具，提供美观、可分享的屏幕录制功能。支持视频录制、编辑与快速分享，采用 Rust + Tauri 构建桌面端，Next.js + React 开发 Web 端，基于 MySQL 和 Drizzle ORM，支持 Docker 一键部署与自托管。
repos.summary_en: Cap is an open-source alternative to Loom, offering beautiful, shareable screen recordings. It enables quick video recording, editing, and sharing via a desktop app (Tauri/Rust) and web interface (Next.js/React), with MySQL backend, Docker deployment, and self-hosting support.

repos.description: 🎬 火宝短剧 - 基于AI的一站式短剧生成平台 《一句话生成完整短剧，从剧本到成片全自动化》  Huobao Drama - An AI-Powered End-to-End Short Drama Generator "One Sentence to Complete Drama: Fully Automated from Script to Final Video"
repos.summary_zh: 火宝短剧是基于AI的一站式短剧生成平台，支持一句话生成完整短剧，实现从剧本创作、角色设计、分镜脚本到成片的全流程自动化。采用Go+Vue3全栈架构，集成大语言模型与文生图/图生视频技术，提供角色管理、智能分镜、视频合成等核心功能，适用于短视频内容工业化生产。
repos.summary_en: Huobao Drama is an AI-powered end-to-end short drama generator that transforms one sentence into a complete drama, automating script creation, character design, storyboarding, and video production. Built with Go + Vue3 stack, it integrates LLMs, text-to-image, and image-to-video models for full workflow automation in short-form content creation.

repos.description: Netflix-level subtitle cutting, translation, alignment, and even dubbing - one-click fully automated AI video subtitle team | Netflix级字幕切割、翻译、对齐、甚至加上配音，一键全自动视频搬运AI字幕组
repos.summary_zh: VideoLingo 是一款全自动 AI 视频字幕处理工具，支持 YouTube 视频下载、WhisperX 精准字幕识别、NLP 驱动的智能分段、术语库构建、Netflix 级单行字幕翻译（三步翻译-反思-适配流程），以及 GPT-SoVITS/Azure/OpenAI 多平台配音，实现一键生成高质量多语言字幕与配音。
repos.summary_en: VideoLingo is an all-in-one AI-powered video translation and dubbing tool that automates YouTube video processing, WhisperX-based word-level subtitle recognition, AI-driven segmentation, custom terminology, Netflix-standard single-line translations via a 3-step Translate-Reflect-Adapt pipeline, and multi-platform dubbing using GPT-SoVITS, Azure, or OpenAI TTS, enabling one-click global video localization.

repos.description: 免费无广告的追剧资源指南，人工精选资源、每天检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox / 影视仓空壳软件/配置地址、IPTV直播源、会员拼团、影视相关开源项目。开源，社区共同维护。

repos.description: 首家工业级全流程 AI 影视生产平台。Industry-first professional AI Agent platform for controllable film & video production. From shorts to live-action with Hollywood-standard workflows.
repos.summary_zh: waoowaoo AI影视工作室是一款工业级全流程AI短剧/漫画视频制作工具，支持从小说文本自动生成分镜、角色和场景，并合成完整视频。具备AI剧本分析、角色场景生成、分镜视频制作及多角色AI配音功能，提供好莱坞标准工作流，支持中英文界面切换，采用Next.js+React技术栈与Docker化部署。
repos.summary_en: waoowaoo is an industrial-grade AI-powered short drama/comic video production platform that automatically generates storyboards, characters, and scenes from novel text, then synthesizes them into complete videos. Features include AI script analysis, character/scene generation, shot-by-shot video creation, multi-role AI voice synthesis, and Hollywood-standard workflows with bilingual support and Docker-based deployment using Next.js + React.

repos.description: 一个第三方音乐播放器、本地服务、桌面歌词、音乐下载、远程控制
repos.summary_zh: AlgerMusicPlayer 是一款功能强大的第三方跨平台音乐播放器，支持网易云账号登录、本地服务、桌面歌词、音乐下载及远程控制。基于 Electron 和 Vue 开发，提供沉浸式歌词显示、EQ均衡器、多语言界面和明暗主题切换，支持全平台运行（桌面/Web/移动端），兼顾高品质音质与个性化体验。
repos.summary_en: AlgerMusicPlayer is a powerful third-party cross-platform music player supporting NetEase Cloud login, local services, desktop lyrics, music downloads, and remote control. Built with Electron and Vue, it offers immersive lyrics, EQ equalizer, multi-language UI, dark/light themes, and high-fidelity audio, running on Desktop, Web, and Mobile platforms with personalized features.

repos.description: TikTok 发布/喜欢/合辑/直播/视频/图集/音乐；抖音发布/喜欢/收藏/收藏夹/视频/图集/实况/直播/音乐/合集/评论/账号/搜索/热榜数据采集工具/下载工具
repos.summary_zh: DouK-Downloader 是一款基于 Python 和 HTTPX 的免费开源数据采集工具，支持批量下载抖音/TikTok 视频、图集、直播、合集及评论数据。具备 Web UI、API 接口、多线程下载、代理支持、增量采集、文件断点续传等功能，可部署至私有或公开服务器，适用于内容创作者、数据分析师等场景。
repos.summary_en: DouK-Downloader is a free open-source data collection tool built with Python and HTTPX, enabling batch downloads of videos, albums, live streams, collections, and comments from Douyin/TikTok. It features Web UI, API interface, multi-threaded downloads, proxy support, incremental scraping, and resume capability, deployable on private or public servers for content creators and data analysts.

repos.description: OK影视、tvbox配置文件，如果喜欢，请Fork自用。使用前请仔细阅读仓库说明，一旦使用将被视为你已了解。
repos.summary_zh: qist/tvbox 是一个 TVBox 和猫影视的配置文件仓库，提供多套 OK 影视、饭太硬、猫影视等第三方接口配置，支持直播、点播、阿里云盘解析等功能。包含多种优化配置（如多线路、极简版、JS 脚本集成），适配主流播放器应用，强调合法合规使用，禁止商业用途。
repos.summary_en: qist/tvbox is a repository providing configuration files for TVBox and CatVod platforms, including OK影视, FTFH, and other third-party sources. It offers multiple optimized configurations (e.g., multi-line, minimal, JS scripts) supporting live streaming, video-on-demand, and cloud drive parsing via Aliyun Pan. Designed for use with apps like OK影视 and CatVodOpen, it emphasizes legal compliance and prohibits commercial use.

repos.description: 首家工业级全流程 AI 影视生产平台。Industry-first professional AI Agent platform for controllable film & video production. From shorts to live-action with Hollywood-standard workflows.
repos.summary_zh: waoowaoo 是全球首家工业级全流程 AI 影视生产平台，支持从小说文本自动生成分镜、角色、场景并合成完整视频。具备 AI 剧本分析、角色场景生成、分镜视频制作、AI 多角色配音及双语界面等核心功能，采用 Next.js 15 + Docker 架构，提供好莱坞标准工作流，适用于短剧与漫画视频创作。
repos.summary_en: waoowaoo is the world's first industrial-grade AI-powered film and video production platform, enabling end-to-end creation from novel text to final video with storyboard generation, character/scene synthesis, and multi-character voiceover. Built on Next.js 15 and Docker, it offers Hollywood-standard workflows for short dramas and comic videos, featuring bilingual UI and seamless API integration.

repos.description: 利用 AI 大模型，一键解说并剪辑视频
repos.summary_zh: NarratoAI 是一款基于 AI 大模型的自动化影视解说与剪辑工具，支持一键生成文案、自动剪辑视频、配音及字幕。通过整合 LLM 实现从内容创作到视频制作的全流程自动化，显著提升短视频生产效率，适用于短剧解说、影视混剪等场景。
repos.summary_en: NarratoAI is an AI-powered automated video commentary and editing tool that enables one-click generation of scripts, automatic video editing, voiceover, and subtitle creation. It integrates LLMs to streamline the entire content production pipeline, significantly boosting efficiency for short-form video creation and film dubbing.

repos.description: 免费无广告的追剧资源指南，人工精选资源、每天检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox / 影视仓空壳软件/配置地址、IPTV直播源、会员拼团、影视相关开源项目。开源，社区共同维护。

repos.description: 本项目采用 CC BY-NC-SA 协议，禁止任何商业化行为，任何衍生项目必须保留本项目地址并以相同协议开源
repos.summary_zh: MoonTV 是一款基于 Next.js 14 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS 构建的跨平台影视聚合播放器，支持多源搜索、在线 HLS 播放、收藏同步及 PWA 离线缓存。采用 Kvrocks/Redis 存储播放进度，集成 ArtPlayer 与 HLS.js 实现流畅播放体验，支持响应式设计与智能去广告功能。
repos.summary_en: MoonTV is a cross-platform video aggregation player built with Next.js 14, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. It supports multi-source search, HLS streaming via ArtPlayer/HLS.js, cloud-synced watchlist, and PWA offline caching. Uses Kvrocks/Redis for playback progress storage with responsive UI and experimental ad-blocking.

repos.description: 🐸 Read Frog - Open-source AI language learning & flashcards, an Immersive Translate alternative | 🐸 陪读蛙 - 开源 AI 语言学习与闪词卡，沉浸式翻译替代
repos.summary_zh: Read Frog 是一款开源浏览器 AI 语言学习扩展，支持沉浸式翻译、文章分析、多 AI 模型适配及字幕翻译。提供双语对照、上下文感知翻译、自定义提示词、批量请求和文本转语音功能，覆盖 Chrome/Edge/Firefox，助力用户高效深度学习。
repos.summary_en: Read Frog is an open-source browser extension for AI-powered language learning, offering immersive translation, article analysis, subtitle translation, and TTS. It supports bilingual mode, context-aware translation, custom prompts, batch requests, and integrates 20+ AI providers across Chrome, Edge, and Firefox.

repos.description: 首家工业级全流程 AI 影视生产平台。Industry-first professional AI Agent platform for controllable film & video production. From shorts to live-action with Hollywood-standard workflows.
repos.summary_zh: waoowaoo AI 影视 Studio 是首家工业级全流程可控协作式专业 AI 智能体影视生产平台，支持从小说文本自动生成分镜、角色、场景并制作成完整视频，涵盖短片到漫剧再到真人级影视剧的全流程制作，采用好莱坞专业制作团队思路，提供虚拟制片场体验。
repos.summary_en: waoowaoo AI Studio is the first industrial-grade, end-to-end controllable collaborative AI agent platform for professional film and TV production, supporting full-process creation from short films to anime series and feature films. It automatically generates storyboards, characters, and scenes from novel text and assembles them into complete videos, following Hollywood-level production workflows.

repos.description: Create stunning demos for free. Open-source, no subscriptions, no watermarks, and free for commercial use. An alternative to Screen Studio.
repos.summary_zh: OpenScreen 是一款免费开源的屏幕录制工具，提供无广告、无订阅、商业可用的屏幕录制与编辑功能，支持自定义缩放、背景、注释及导出设置，适用于制作产品演示和教程视频，是 Screen Studio 的轻量级替代方案。
repos.summary_en: OpenScreen is a free, open-source screen recording tool offering watermark-free, subscription-free recordings with customizable zooms, backgrounds, annotations, and export options. Ideal for product demos and tutorials, it serves as a lightweight alternative to Screen Studio.

repos.description: FongMi影视和tvbox配置文件，如果喜欢，请Fork自用。使用前请仔细阅读仓库说明，一旦使用将被视为你已了解。
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供FongMi影视、TVBox及猫影视的多种配置文件（如0707.json、0821.json等），集成多线路直播、自动换源、点播解析等功能，支持主流TVBox应用。资源源自社区大神分享，包含第三方配置源与随机壁纸API，适用于家庭影院系统搭建，仅供个人学习研究使用。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers multiple configuration files for FongMi影视, TVBox, and CatVod platforms (e.g., 0707.json, 0821.json), supporting multi-line live streaming, automatic source switching, and video playback parsing. It integrates community-sourced third-party APIs and random wallpaper services, designed for home theater setups. Intended strictly for personal learning and research use.

repos.description: A lightweight screen recorder based on ScreenCapture Kit for macOS / 基于 ScreenCapture Kit 的轻量化多功能 macOS 录屏工具
repos.summary_zh: QuickRecorder 是一款基于 ScreenCapture Kit 的轻量级高性能 macOS 录屏工具，支持屏幕、窗口、应用及移动设备录制。具备免驱音频回环、鼠标高亮、屏幕放大镜等功能，并完整支持 macOS 14 的 Presenter Overlay 实时摄像头叠加，以及 HEVC with Alpha 格式输出（含透明通道），适用于专业视频制作与会议录制。
repos.summary_en: QuickRecorder is a lightweight, high-performance screen recorder for macOS built on ScreenCapture Kit. It supports recording screens, windows, apps, and mobile devices with features like driver-free audio loopback, mouse highlighting, and screen magnifier. It fully supports macOS 14's Presenter Overlay for real-time camera overlay and HEVC with Alpha output (with alpha channel), ideal for professional video editing and conferencing.

repos.description: 插件化、定制化、无广告的免费音乐播放器
repos.summary_zh: MusicFree 桌面版是一款插件化、无广告的免费音乐播放器，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。其核心特性包括：通过插件机制接入任意音源（如搜索、播放、歌单导入），高度定制化主题系统（支持 CSS 变量与 iframe 背景），以及本地数据存储保障隐私。用户可自由扩展音源与界面风格，实现个性化音乐体验。
repos.summary_en: MusicFree Desktop is a plugin-based, ad-free, open-source music player supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. Key features include: plugin-driven access to any audio source (search, playback, playlist import), highly customizable themes via CSS variables and iframe backgrounds, and local data storage for privacy. Users can extend sources and personalize UI freely.

repos.description: Multi-account API gateway for Grok Build, Grok Web, and Grok Console
repos.summary_zh: Grok2API 是基于 FastAPI 构建的 Grok AI 逆向工程接口，全面兼容 OpenAI API 格式，支持流式对话、图像/视频生成编辑、工具调用、NSFW 模式及号池负载均衡，提供 Docker/Vercel/Render 一键部署方案。
repos.summary_en: Grok2API is a FastAPI-based reverse-engineered interface for Grok AI, fully compatible with OpenAI API format. It supports streaming/non-streaming chat, image/video generation/editing, tool calls, NSFW mode, and account pool load balancing, with one-click deployment via Docker/Vercel/Render.

repos.description: 用文本编辑器剪视频
repos.summary_zh: AutoCut 是一款基于 Whisper 字幕识别的视频剪辑工具，用户通过编辑 Markdown 文件选择保留片段，即可自动裁切视频。支持多种 Whisper 模型（含 large-v3-turbo 加速版）、faster-whisper 及 OpenAI API，兼容本地与 Docker 部署，无需专业视频软件即可完成精准剪辑。
repos.summary_en: AutoCut is a video editing tool that uses Whisper-based automatic subtitle generation. Users select clips by editing Markdown files, enabling precise video cutting without professional software. It supports multiple Whisper models (including large-v3-turbo for speed), faster-whisper, and OpenAI API, with local and Docker deployment options.

repos.description: 截屏 离线OCR 搜索翻译 以图搜图 贴图 录屏 万向滚动截屏 屏幕翻译   Screenshot  Offline OCR   Search   Translate   Search for picture   Paste the picture on the screen   Screen recorder   Omnidirectional scrolling screenshot   Screen translator  支持Windows Linux macOS
repos.summary_zh: eSearch 是一款跨平台屏幕搜索工具，集成截屏、离线OCR、翻译、以图搜图、贴图、录屏和万向滚动截屏功能。基于 Electron 开发，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，提供高度自定义的 OCR 识别、多引擎翻译及 AI 图像交互能力，适用于高效信息提取与屏幕内容管理。
repos.summary_en: eSearch is a cross-platform screen search tool featuring screenshot, offline OCR, translation, reverse image search, screen overlay, screencasting, and omnidirectional scrolling capture. Built with Electron for Windows, Linux, and macOS, it offers customizable OCR, multi-engine translation, and AI-powered image interaction for efficient content extraction and management.

repos.description: One UI is all done with chatgpt web, midjourney, gpts,suno,luma,runway,viggle,flux,ideogram,realtime,pika,udio; Simultaneous support  Web / PWA / Linux / Win / MacOS platform
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个集成 ChatGPT、MidJourney、Suno、Luma、Runway、Viggle、Flux、Ideogram、Pika 等多模态 AI 服务的统一前端界面，支持 Web/PWA/Linux/Win/MacOS 全平台运行，提供文生图、图生视频、语音识别、Gpts 多模态交互等功能，并支持自定义 API Key 与 one-api/new-api 部署。
repos.summary_en: This project is a unified frontend interface integrating multiple AI services including ChatGPT, MidJourney, Suno, Luma, Runway, Viggle, Flux, Ideogram, and Pika. It supports multimodal generation (text-to-image/video/audio), browser-based ASR, GPTs, and runs on Web/PWA/Linux/Win/MacOS. Features custom API keys, one-api/new-api deployment, and local image storage.

repos.description: 艺术动画skill：35种艺术风格、9种解说语法，用代码让画动起来。
repos.summary_zh: 生成失败
repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: TVBox 网络接口，更新速度快，接口访问速度快且稳定！
repos.summary_zh: TVBox 提供高速稳定的网络接口，支持多加速访问源，但官方已推荐迁移至功能更丰富的 OK影视。该项目主要用于构建电视直播与点播应用，强调接口响应速度与稳定性，适用于各类智能电视及移动端播放平台。
repos.summary_en: TVBox offers a fast and stable network interface with multiple CDN acceleration sources. Although it no longer supports TVBox, the project recommends migrating to OK影视 for enhanced features and mobile support. It is designed for building IPTV and video-on-demand applications with high performance.

repos.description: AIGCPanel 是一个简单易用的一站式AI数字人系统，支持视频合成、声音合成、声音克隆，简化本地模型管理、一键导入和使用AI模型。
repos.summary_zh: AIGCPanel 是一款集成视频合成、语音合成与克隆的一体化AI数字人系统，支持多模态模型一键导入与管理。基于Electron+Vue3+TypeScript构建，提供跨平台桌面应用，内置CosyVoice、MuseTalk等主流模型，简化本地AI创作流程，适合非技术用户快速生成逼真数字人内容。
repos.summary_en: AIGCPanel is an all-in-one AI digital human system featuring video synthesis, voice synthesis, and cloning. It supports one-click model import/management of mainstream models like CosyVoice and MuseTalk. Built with Electron+Vue3+TypeScript for cross-platform desktop deployment, it simplifies local AI content creation for non-technical users.

repos.description: 一个基于 React Native TVOS 和 Expo 构建的播放器，旨在提供流畅的视频观看体验。
repos.summary_zh: OrionTV 是基于 React Native TVOS 和 Expo 构建的跨平台电视播放器，专为 Apple TV 和 Android TV 设计。采用 TypeScript + Expo Router 实现现代化前端架构，集成 TV 优化 UI 与视频流服务，提供流畅的影视内容观看体验，依赖 MoonTV 作为后端数据源。
repos.summary_en: OrionTV is a cross-platform TV player built with React Native TVOS and Expo, supporting Apple TV and Android TV. It features a modern frontend using TypeScript, Expo Router, and TV-optimized UI for seamless video playback, powered by MoonTV as its backend content provider.

repos.description: Open-source, accurate and easy-to-use video speech recognition & clipping tool, LLM based AI clipping intergrated.
repos.summary_zh: FunClip 是一款开源、精准且易用的视频语音识别与剪辑工具，集成阿里巴巴通义语音实验室开源的 FunASR Paraformer 系列模型，支持中文及英文语音识别，具备热词定制、说话人分离、多段自由剪辑等功能，并引入 LLM 智能剪辑能力，用户可通过 Gradio 界面快速生成精准视频片段与字幕。
repos.summary_en: FunClip is an open-source, accurate, and user-friendly video speech recognition and clipping tool. It leverages Alibaba's FunASR Paraformer models for ASR, supports Chinese and English, enables hotword customization, speaker separation, multi-segment clipping, and integrates LLM-based AI clipping via Qwen/GPT series models with customizable prompts for intelligent video editing.

repos.description: AI 视频笔记生成工具 让 AI 为你的视频做笔记
repos.summary_zh: BiliNote 是一款开源 AI 视频笔记生成工具，支持哔哩哔哩、YouTube、抖音等平台视频链接自动提取内容，结合 GPT 或通义千问等模型生成结构化 Markdown 笔记，支持插入截图、跳转链接及多版本记录，提供本地部署与在线体验。
repos.summary_en: BiliNote is an open-source AI video note generator that automatically extracts content from Bilibili, YouTube, Douyin, and other platforms to create structured Markdown notes using GPT, DeepSeek, or Qwen models. It supports screenshots, jump links, multiple versions, and local deployment with optional CUDA acceleration.

repos.description: 微信视频号下载器
repos.summary_zh: 微信视频号下载器是一款轻量级跨平台工具，支持 Windows 和 macOS 系统，通过注入浏览器扩展实现一键下载视频号视频。无需登录或复杂配置，自动安装证书并启动代理服务，在微信 PC 端界面直接添加下载按钮，支持多画质选择，下载完成后自动展示文件信息，体积小巧且操作简便。
repos.summary_en: WeChat Channels Video Downloader is a lightweight cross-platform tool for Windows and macOS that enables one-click downloading of videos from WeChat Channels. It automatically installs certificates, starts a proxy service, and injects download buttons into the WeChat PC client interface. Users can select video quality (e.g., xWT111, xWT98) and download files with metadata displayed post-download, offering a simple and efficient experience.

repos.description: An unofficial bilibili client for mac
repos.summary_zh: Bilibili Mac Client 是一款非官方哔哩哔哩桌面客户端，基于 mpv 实现硬解播放与 libass 弹幕渲染，支持多视频网站解析、分段视频拼接、弹幕发送与屏蔽、本地视频播放及自定义配置，显著降低 CPU 占用并优化能效表现。
repos.summary_en: An unofficial Bilibili desktop client for macOS, built on mpv with hardware decoding and libass-based danmaku rendering. It supports multi-site video parsing, segmented video stitching, danmaku interaction, local playback, and extensive customization via mpv config, offering superior performance and energy efficiency compared to HTML5 players.

repos.description: Multi-Platform Live Stream Automatic Recording Tool | 多平台直播流自动录制客户端 · 基于FFmpeg · 支持监控/定时/转码
repos.summary_zh: StreamCap 是一款基于 FFmpeg 的多平台直播流自动录制工具，支持 40+ 国内外主流直播平台（如抖音、B站、Twitch、TikTok），具备循环监控、定时录制、批量任务管理和自动转码功能，提供 Windows/macOS/Linux/Web 全平台支持，适用于内容存档与直播数据分析。
repos.summary_en: StreamCap is a multi-platform live stream recording tool powered by FFmpeg and StreamGet, supporting 40+ global platforms (e.g., Douyin, Bilibili, Twitch, TikTok). It features real-time monitoring, scheduled recording, batch processing, and automatic transcoding, with full support for Windows, macOS, Linux, and web deployment for content archiving and live data analysis.

repos.description: Experimental
repos.summary_zh: Box 是一个实验性项目，核心功能为通过修改 App.java 配置文件调整应用默认设置，包括播放类型、解码方式、历史记录数量等参数。
repos.summary_en: Box is an experimental project focused on configuring default app settings via App.java, including playback type, decoding mode, DNS, and UI preferences.

repos.description: 一句话：试错成本越来越高，提示词的重要性从来没有像今天这样大。Seedance 2.0 Storyboard Generator 开源剧情剧本Skill工具，帮佬友一键写好剧本 - 将小说/故事转化为多集视频。 为什么做这个？ 因为 seedance2 已经改变了一切，需要新的剧本剧情制作工具，更好的利用新AI的能力和更方便的制作短剧
repos.summary_zh: Seedance2-Storyboard-Generator 是一个基于 Claude Code + Skill + Seedance 2.0 的 AI 视频制作工作流，专为将小说/故事高效转化为多集短视频系列而设计。通过自动化剧本创作、素材生成与分镜脚本编写，实现从文字到成片的全流程智能化生产，显著降低内容创作门槛。
repos.summary_en: Seedance2-Storyboard-Generator is an AI-powered video production workflow leveraging Claude Code, Skills, and Seedance 2.0 to transform novels/stories into multi-episode short video series. It automates scriptwriting, asset generation, and storyboard creation, enabling end-to-end intelligent content production with minimal manual effort.

repos.description: 《面向开发者的 ChatGPT 提示词工程》非官方版中英双语字幕 Unofficial subtitles of "ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers"
repos.summary_zh: 该项目为非官方中英双语字幕，涵盖吴恩达与 OpenAI 开发者合著的《ChatGPT 提示工程》课程，重点讲解面向开发者的 Prompt 编写技巧，包括文本分类、摘要、翻译、聊天机器人构建等 9 个实战章节，配套交互式 Notebook 与 B 站视频，助力开发者掌握高杠杆 AI 技能。
repos.summary_en: This project provides unofficial bilingual Chinese-English subtitles for Andrew Ng and OpenAI's 'ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers' course, covering 9 practical chapters on prompt writing, including text classification, summarization, translation, and chatbot development, with interactive notebooks and Bilibili videos to help developers master this high-leverage AI skill.

repos.description: 妈妈计划-众人拾柴火焰高
repos.summary_zh: 妈妈计划2（MAMA2）是一个开源项目，旨在解决MacBook观看在线视频时发热严重的问题，通过将Flash播放器替换为HTML5 Video实现。项目支持哔哩哔哩、优酷、土豆、芒果TV等主流视频网站，采用模块化架构，开发者可编写seeker脚本解析视频源地址。支持本地开发环境搭建，具备跨域请求、日志记录等工具函数，鼓励社区参与扩展支持网站。
repos.summary_en: MAMA2 is an open-source project designed to resolve overheating issues in MacBooks when watching online videos by replacing Flash players with HTML5 Video. It supports major platforms like Bilibili, Youku, Tudou, and more. The project uses a modular architecture where developers can write 'seeker' scripts to extract video URLs. It includes tools for AJAX, logging, and cross-domain requests, with a local development environment using Node.js and Gulp. Community contributions are encouraged to expand site support.

repos.description: 一键将视频转换为优质小红书笔记，自动优化内容和配图
repos.summary_zh: 视频笔记生成器一键将视频内容转换为优质小红书笔记，支持自动语音转文字、AI内容优化、标题创作、配图获取及标签生成。V2.0版本采用FastAPI提供现代化Web界面，支持批量处理、长视频解析、智能错误重试与历史记录管理，显著提升内容创作效率。
repos.summary_en: Video Note Generator automatically converts videos into high-quality Xiaohongshu notes with speech-to-text, AI content optimization, title generation, image fetching, and hashtag creation. V2.0 features a modern FastAPI web interface, batch processing, 30-minute video support, smart retry mechanisms, and history tracking for efficient content production.

repos.description: 将视频瞬间转化为手绘故事 Turn Video Moments into Hand-Drawn Stories
repos.summary_zh: ClipSketch AI 是一款专为视频创作者设计的 AI 驱动内容创作工具，支持解析 Bilibili 和小红书视频链接，实现帧级精准标记，并借助 Google Gemini 多模态模型将精彩瞬间一键转化为手绘风格故事板，自动生成适配社交媒体的爆款文案，涵盖角色融合、封面生成和批量精修功能。
repos.summary_en: ClipSketch AI is an AI-powered content creation tool for video creators, enabling frame-level tagging of Bilibili and Xiaohongshu videos, transforming key moments into hand-drawn storyboards via Google Gemini's multimodal models, and auto-generating social media captions, character fusion, cover images, and batch-enhanced visuals.

repos.description: Browser-based media player and Chrome extension for subtitle sentence mining
repos.summary_zh: asbplayer 是一款基于浏览器的媒体播放器及 Chrome 扩展，专为通过字幕视频学习语言的用户设计。它支持将字幕加载到主流流媒体平台（如 YouTube、Netflix），并提供字幕导航、多播放模式（快进/跳过无字幕片段）、自动暂停等功能，帮助用户高效创建多媒体闪卡并优化语言学习体验。
repos.summary_en: asbplayer is a browser-based media player and Chrome extension tailored for language learners using subtitled content. It enables loading selectable subtitles from streaming platforms like YouTube and Netflix, supports subtitle navigation, playback modes (e.g., condensed/fast-forward), and integrates with tools like Yomitan for word styling and annotation to enhance vocabulary acquisition.

repos.description: 一款功能强大的自动化工具，通过拖拽模块的方式快速构建自动化工作流，无需编写任何代码即可实现网页数据采集、表单填写、自动化测试等任务。  ⬇️⬇️ WebRPA技术交流群 ⬇️⬇️
repos.summary_zh: Web RPA 是一款强大的可视化网页自动化工具，支持零代码拖拽构建自动化工作流，涵盖网页数据采集、表单填写、自动化测试等场景。基于 FastAPI + React 架构，集成 273 个功能模块，涵盖浏览器自动化、数据处理、数据库操作、媒体处理、PDF 转换、文档转换等全栈能力，提供智能搜索、Mermaid 流程图、变量自动补全等高效开发特性，支持非商业免费使用。
repos.summary_en: Web RPA is a powerful visual automation tool enabling zero-code workflow creation via drag-and-drop. It supports web scraping, form filling, and testing with 273 built-in modules across browser automation, data processing, database operations, media handling, PDF conversion, and document transformation. Built on FastAPI + React, it offers smart search, Mermaid flowcharts, variable autocompletion, and full non-commercial free usage.

repos.description: OpenAI-compatible API for Gemini Business with multi-account load balancing and multimodal capabilities (image/video generation, file parsing) | 将 Gemini Business 转为 OpenAI 兼容接口，支持多账户负载均衡及多模态能力（图像生成、视频生成、解析文件）
repos.summary_zh: Gemini Business2API 将 Gemini Business 转换为 OpenAI 兼容接口，支持多账户负载均衡、自动化注册登录、多模态文件解析（100+格式）、图像/视频生成及流式输出。提供 Docker 部署、管理面板和 PostgreSQL/SQLite 存储，适用于个人技术研究与非商业场景。
repos.summary_en: Gemini Business2API converts Gemini Business into an OpenAI-compatible API with multi-account load balancing, automated account management, multimodal file parsing (100+ formats), image/video generation, and streaming responses. Features Docker deployment, admin panel, and PostgreSQL/SQLite persistence for non-commercial research use.

repos.description: 高颜值的第三方网易云播放器；支持流媒体音乐，如navidrome、jellyfin、emby；支持本地音乐播放、离线歌单、逐字歌词、桌面歌词、Touch Bar歌词、Mac状态栏歌词显示、Linux-gnome与Linux-kde桌面状态栏歌词显示；支持降调降速，支持自定义主题等。支持 Windows / macOS / Linux :electron:
repos.summary_zh: VutronMusic 是一款高颜值跨平台第三方网易云音乐播放器，支持本地音乐、流媒体服务（如Navidrome、Jellyfin）、离线歌单及逐字歌词。具备桌面歌词、状态栏歌词、变调变速、自定义主题等功能，采用 Vue3 + TypeScript + Fastify 架构，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux 多平台。
repos.summary_en: VutronMusic is a high-end third-party NetEase Cloud Music player supporting local music, streaming services (Navidrome, Jellyfin), offline playlists, and karaoke-style lyrics. Features include desktop lyrics, system tray display, pitch/speed control, custom themes, and advanced audio effects. Built with Vue3, TypeScript, Fastify, and Electron for cross-platform support.

repos.description: 腾讯会议摸鱼工具
repos.summary_zh: TMSpeech 是一款 Windows 平台的实时语音转文字工具，基于 sherpa-onnx 框架实现中文会议语音识别，支持 WASAPI 内录、实时字幕显示与历史记录保存。具备低 CPU 占用（<5%）、无边框可拖动界面、自定义外部识别器集成等功能，适用于会议转录、走神备忘等场景。
repos.summary_en: TMSpeech is a Windows-based real-time speech-to-text tool using the sherpa-onnx framework for Chinese meeting transcription. It captures system audio via WASAPI, displays live subtitles like lyrics, and saves recognition history. Features include low CPU usage (<5%), draggable UI, and support for custom external recognizers, ideal for meetings and note-taking.

repos.description: Browser-based media player and Chrome extension for subtitle sentence mining
repos.summary_zh: asbplayer 是一款基于浏览器的媒体播放器及 Chrome 扩展，专为通过字幕视频学习语言的用户设计。支持将字幕加载到主流流媒体平台（如 YouTube、Netflix），提供可导航的字幕列表、多种播放模式（如跳过无字幕片段、自动暂停）以及高质量多媒体闪卡生成功能，显著提升语言学习效率。
repos.summary_en: asbplayer is a browser-based media player and Chrome extension tailored for language learners using subtitled videos. It enables loading selectable subtitles onto streaming platforms like YouTube and Netflix, supports navigable subtitle lists, condensed playback modes, and multimedia flashcard creation to optimize vocabulary acquisition.

repos.description: 直播源检索、测速、优选
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供高效电视直播源检索、测速与优选工具，基于FFmpeg实现多维度视频流质量检测（卡顿、延迟、丢帧等），自动筛选高速稳定源并生成订阅链接。支持本地网络环境适配，每日自动更新，优化高清源加载体验，适用于安卓直播软件壳配置使用。
repos.summary_en: This repository delivers a high-efficiency TV live stream retrieval, speed testing, and optimization tool. It uses FFmpeg for multi-dimensional quality checks (lag, buffering, frame drops) to automatically select fast and stable streams, generating subscription links. Supports local network adaptation, daily updates, and optimized HD loading, ideal for Android live-streaming apps.

repos.description: 可商业化的 AI Web 平台，提供一站式人工智能服务解决方案。支持私有化部署，内置多用户管理，适合企业、团队或个人快速构建 AI 服务。
repos.summary_zh: 99AI 是一个可商业化的 AI Web 平台，提供一站式人工智能服务解决方案。支持私有化部署与多用户管理，集成 AI 对话、深度思考、联网搜索、智能图表生成及自定义应用广场等功能，适用于企业、团队或个人快速构建商业化 AI 服务。
repos.summary_en: 99AI is a commercializable AI web platform offering an all-in-one AI service solution. It supports private deployment, multi-user management, and integrates features like AI chat, deep thinking models, web search, intelligent diagram generation, and customizable agent apps for rapid enterprise or team AI service development.

repos.description: 自动视频生成器，给定主题，自动生成解说视频。用户输入主题文字，系统调用大语言模型生成故事或解说的文字，然后进一步调用语音合成接口生成解说的语音，调用文生图接口生成契合文字内容的配图，最后融合语音和配图生成解说视频。
repos.summary_zh: 自动视频生成器通过大语言模型生成解说文本，调用语音合成与文生图接口生成音视频素材，最终合成主题解说视频。支持PPT/PDF输入、免费资源校对、千帆ERNIE模型及百度千帆平台集成，提供Gradio交互界面与完整工作流。
repos.summary_en: Auto Video Generator creates explanatory videos by generating text via LLMs, synthesizing speech, producing images via text-to-image models, and combining them into final videos. It supports PPT/PDF input, free resource checking, integrates with Baidu Qianfan's ERNIE models, and offers a Gradio-based interactive interface with full workflow automation.

repos.description: 小视频宝：AI 驱动的视频生成工具，一键生成高质量营销视频 AI-powered video generation tool for creating high-quality marketing videos with one click.
repos.summary_zh: ClipTurbo 是一款 AI 驱动的短视频生成工具，专为营销视频创作设计。利用 AI 处理文案、翻译、图标匹配及 TTS 语音合成，结合 manim 渲染引擎输出高质量视频，有效规避平台限流风险。支持多分辨率、自定义字体与背景音乐，提供 Windows 客户端及即将上线的 Web 版本，助力用户快速变现短视频内容。
repos.summary_en: ClipTurbo is an AI-powered video generation tool focused on creating high-quality marketing videos. It leverages AI for script processing, translation, icon matching, and TTS synthesis, rendering videos via manim to avoid platform restrictions. Features include customizable resolution, fonts, and background music, with a Windows client and upcoming web version, enabling rapid monetization of short-form video content.

repos.description: 文档（小说、论文、字幕）翻译工具（支持 pdf/word/excel/json/epub/srt...）Document (Novel, Thesis, Subtitle) Translation Tool (Supports pdf/word/excel/json/epub/srt...)
repos.summary_zh: DocuTranslate 是一款基于大语言模型的本地文档翻译工具，支持 PDF、Word、Excel、JSON、EPUB、SRT 等多种格式。具备自动术语表生成、PDF 表格/公式/代码识别、JSON 路径翻译、格式保留、多 AI 平台支持、异步高并发处理、局域网多用户共享及交互式 Web 界面等功能。提供便携版安装包，适合小说、论文、字幕等场景的批量翻译。
repos.summary_en: DocuTranslate is a lightweight local document translation tool powered by Large Language Models. It supports multiple formats including PDF, Word, Excel, JSON, EPUB, and SRT. Features include automatic glossary generation, PDF table/formula/code recognition, JSON path-based translation, format preservation, multi-AI platform support, async concurrency, LAN multi-user access, and an integrated Web UI. Ideal for translating novels, academic papers, and subtitles with portable installers under 40MB.

repos.description: 🦄 The world's largest Midjourney drawing API, generating over 1 million drawings daily, supporting Discord Youchuan Midjourney 🐂！
repos.summary_zh: Midjourney API 是全球最大的 Midjourney 绘图 API 代理项目，日生成图像超百万张，完全免费开源。支持 Discord 绘图、悠船绘图及官网接入，提供 Imagine、Vary、Remix 等全套指令，集成账号池管理、多数据库支持、负载均衡、CloudFlare 验证绕过、图片/视频一键换脸等功能，适用于企业级绘图服务部署。
repos.summary_en: Midjourney API is the world's largest free and open-source proxy for Midjourney's Discord channel, generating over 1 million images daily. It supports full-featured drawing via Discord, YouChuan, and official Midjourney, with comprehensive commands like Imagine, Vary, Remix, account pooling, load balancing, CloudFlare bypass, image/video face swap, and enterprise-grade deployment features.

repos.description: Python爬虫，返回一定格式的信息，下载，使用flask提供简易api。抖音无水印、皮皮虾、快手、网易云音乐、qq音乐、咪咕音乐、荔枝FM音频、知乎视频、最右语音、视频、微博......
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Python 的网页爬虫集合，支持抖音、快手、网易云音乐、知乎等平台的无水印视频、音频及内容下载，通过 Flask 提供简易 API 接口。代码风格较旧但功能实用，现计划迁移至 FastAPI 框架重构，适合学习或日常使用。
repos.summary_en: This project is a collection of Python web crawlers for downloading unwatermarked videos, audio, and content from platforms like Douyin, Kuaishou, NetEase Music, and Zhihu. It provides a simple API via Flask. The codebase is outdated but functional, with plans to migrate to FastAPI for better structure and usability.

repos.description: Versatile downloader for audio, video, podcasts, PDFs and more. Available as CLI and Docker | 多功能下载工具，支持音视频、播客、PDF等，提供 CLI 和 Docker 两种方式
repos.summary_zh: vget 是一款多功能下载工具，支持从音视频、播客、社交媒体（如小红书、Twitter）及WebDAV等资源下载内容，提供 CLI 和 Docker 部署方式，具备多语言支持和交互式配置向导，适用于跨平台自动化下载场景。
repos.summary_en: vget is a versatile downloader supporting audio, video, podcasts, PDFs, and social media content from platforms like Xiaohongshu and Twitter. It offers CLI and Docker deployment, multi-language support, and interactive configuration, ideal for cross-platform automated downloads.

repos.description: Create stunning screen recordings for free. Open-source, no subscriptions, no watermarks, and free for commercial use. An alternative to Screen Studio.
repos.summary_zh: CursorLens 是一款免费开源的屏幕录制与编辑工具，专为创作者、开发者和团队设计。基于 OpenScreen 构建，深度优化 macOS 原生捕获流程，支持全屏/窗口录制、摄像头画中画、语音录制、时间轴剪辑、字幕生成及多比例导出，无水印且商用免费。
repos.summary_en: CursorLens is a free, open-source screen recorder and editor built on OpenScreen, enhanced for native macOS capture and editing. It supports full-screen/app recording, camera overlay, voice input, timeline editing, subtitle generation, and multi-aspect export—all watermark-free and commercially usable.

repos.description: 使用任何设备(浏览器)作为mac的副屏(随航) 将Android平板用作Mac的第二台显示器 还能在Win和Linux镜像屏幕
repos.summary_zh: 咩Display 是一款跨平台屏幕镜像工具，支持将任意带浏览器的设备（如 Android 平板）作为 Mac 的副屏，实现类似 Apple 随航的功能。基于 ffmpeg 实时转码，支持 mjpg、vp8、h264、hevc 多种编码，延迟低至 100ms（mjpg 模式），适用于 Windows/Linux 屏幕镜像。内置自动旋转、全屏切换，支持通过 ADB 实现 Android 有线连接，适合多屏办公与移动场景。
repos.summary_en: meDisplay is a cross-platform screen mirroring tool that turns any browser-equipped device (e.g., Android tablet) into a secondary display for Mac, mimicking Apple's Sidecar. Built with real-time ffmpeg transcoding, it supports mjpg, vp8, h264, and hevc encoding with ultra-low latency (as low as 100ms in mjpg mode). Also supports Windows/Linux X11 mirroring, auto-rotation, fullscreen toggle, and ADB-based Android wired connection for seamless multi-screen workflows.

repos.description: 月饼TV
repos.summary_zh: MoonCakeTV 是一个基于 Next.js 15 和 TypeScript 的影视聚合搜索服务，支持多源聚合搜索（苹果CMS v10协议）、HLS.js 在线播放、收藏与历史记录、响应式深色主题及可选密码保护，数据持久化存储无需数据库，支持一键 Docker 部署与 HTTPS 自动配置。
repos.summary_en: MoonCakeTV is a simple yet powerful video aggregation and search service built with Next.js 15 and TypeScript. It supports multi-source search via AppleCMS v10 protocol, HLS.js streaming, favorites, watch history, responsive dark mode, optional password protection, and stores data without a database. Features one-click Docker deployment with automatic HTTPS via Caddy.

repos.description: 2023年4、5月份心血来潮，想做TK，为了实现矩阵运营，开启此项目，但是最后由于各种原因，无法继续。现在将项目公开，希望能对后面做自媒体的有所帮助。本项目包括本地代理IP的配置，outlook邮箱申请（图片验证需要手动处理一下），邮箱验证码自动读取，tk账号注册和登录（这里也存在问题，单次可行，第二次会被识别次数太多，细节看readme），tk的模拟浏览视频，tk视频下载，视频搬运前的剪辑处理等等
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是一套针对TikTok自媒体矩阵运营的自动化工具，涵盖Outlook邮箱注册与验证码自动抓取、TikTok账号注册登录、模拟浏览行为、无水印视频下载及智能剪辑处理。通过IP代理轮换、魔改Chrome浏览器、指纹伪装和反爬策略实现稳定运行，结合剪映API与FFmpeg实现视频去头尾、画中画、抽帧等高级编辑功能，为跨境内容创作者提供端到端解决方案。
repos.summary_en: This project is an end-to-end automation toolkit for TikTok content creators and matrix operators. It includes Outlook email registration with auto-verification code retrieval, TikTok account signup/login, simulated browsing behavior, watermark-free video downloads, and intelligent video editing via CapCut API and FFmpeg. Features include IP rotation, anti-detection browser fingerprinting, and advanced video processing such as trim, PIP, frame sampling, and signature obfuscation.

repos.summary_en: TvBox is an open-source TV box interface project offering a simple API for video playback and channel management, ideal for building custom streaming applications.

repos.description: 使用 Gemini (Nano Banano 和 Veo) 的短视频和漫画创作工具
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Gemini Nano Banano 和 VEO 的短视频与漫画创作工具，支持剧本导入、AI 生成分镜图/视频、角色一致性管理及画布视图，提供完整的内容创作工作流，适用于自媒体、IP 孵化等场景。
repos.summary_en: A video and comic creation tool powered by Gemini (Nano Banano and VEO), featuring script import, AI-generated storyboards/videos, character consistency management, and canvas view, enabling end-to-end content production for creators and IP developers.

repos.summary_zh: TVBOX 是一个专为个人使用的电视盒子应用，提供丰富的影视资源聚合与播放功能，支持多源切换、高清流畅播放及自定义配置，适用于家庭娱乐场景。
repos.summary_en: TVBOX is a personal-use TV box application that aggregates and plays rich video content from multiple sources, supporting high-definition streaming, source switching, and custom configurations for home entertainment.
